news.title: Two dozen commercial establishments sealed in residential areas of Bhopal
news.para: Bhopal Municipal Corporation began sealing commercial properties operating from residential areas. Officials have sealed about two dozen properties after issuing many notices. Traders protested, claiming they received overnight notices and lacked relocation options. The corporation stated actions follow previous warnings and legal procedures. Disputes arose, and traders' associations demanded a stay on the corporation's actions.

news.title: Navi Mumbai civic body identifies 34 ‘highly dangerous’ buildings, appeals to residents to vacate immediately
news.para: Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation has identified thirty-four highly dangerous structures.  Occupiers of these unsafe buildings have been issued immediate vacating notices.  Turbe ward reported the highest number of these dangerous buildings.  The corporation warned of potential collapse and financial losses for occupants.  Authorities will disconnect utilities for buildings in the C-1 category.

news.title: Gurugram's built-up area expands 64% in a decade: GIS study
news.para: Gurugram's built-up area grew by sixty-four percent over the past decade.  Future urbanisation is projected along key growth corridors through twenty thirty.  Improved connectivity and economic activity are driving this significant urban expansion.  Geospatial technology aids data-driven planning for infrastructure and development needs.  This study guides future investments for a sustainable and well-connected city.

news.title: Lodha Developers to monetise 150 acres at data centre park in Mumbai region for ₹10,000 crore
news.para: Lodha Developers plans to sell 150 acres of land for nearly ten thousand crore rupees. This land sale is part of their asset monetisation strategy over the next few years. The company is targeting twenty percent annual growth in net profit this fiscal year. Lodha Developers achieved its best-ever quarterly profit during the April-June period. The firm also reported a four percent growth in sales bookings during April-June.

news.title: Mumbai: BMC offers up to 15% property tax rebate for societies under decentralised waste processing mission
news.para: Mumbai's BMC is launching a decentralized waste processing mission. This initiative aims to reduce landfill dependence and long-distance garbage transport. Bulk waste generators will receive assistance to set up on-site processing systems. Housing societies can earn property tax rebates for scientific wet waste processing. This move promotes a circular economy and reduces greenhouse gas emissions.

news.title: Govt to take back plots if no house is built within five years, refund cost with interest: Karnataka CM
news.para: Karnataka government will reclaim vacant housing sites if construction is not completed within five years.  Allottees will receive a refund of their payment along with accrued interest.  This policy aims to prevent plots from becoming garbage dumping grounds.  Beneficiaries have a responsibility to build houses and maintain their allotted properties.  The government expects property owners to fulfill their civic duty diligently.

news.title: After Mumbai pilot, micro-zoning for property rates to reach Thane, Navi Mumbai
news.para: Maharashtra will extend its micro-zoning property valuation system to Thane and Navi Mumbai. This reform replaces uniform Ready Reckoner rates with development-based valuations. A pilot survey is underway in Mumbai, which will inform the rollout. The new system aims for more transparent and equitable property valuations. This initiative will benefit middle-class homebuyers and slum residents across the state.

news.title: Maharashtra plans land titling law, property cards for all owners
news.para: Maharashtra will soon introduce a Land Titling Act for digital property titles. This new law aims to replace existing ownership records with government-backed digital titles. The proposed framework, modeled on Dubai and Singapore, will be placed before the legislature. A mandatory measurement policy will precede property registration, streamlining transactions. Individual vertical property cards will be issued to urban cooperative housing society owners.

news.title: Nagpur civic body collects ₹100 crore in property tax in four months
news.para: Nagpur Municipal Corporation has collected over Rs100 crore in property tax by July 30. This collection represents a significant portion of the annual demand, driven by early payment rebates. Taxpayers received incentives for online and timely payments, encouraging prompt tax submission. Several zones contributed substantially, with Laxmi Nagar leading the revenue generation efforts. The civic body continues recovery measures and technology use for improved tax compliance.

news.title: Simplify procedures, protect homebuyers’ interests, Bihar CM directs RERA
news.para: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary urged RERA to simplify procedures and enhance transparency. He emphasized greater technology adoption for more efficient and investor-friendly services.  The Chief Minister stressed protecting homebuyers' interests and ensuring a responsive grievance mechanism.  Officials were directed to integrate RERA operations with state government digital platforms.  Safeguarding homebuyers' rights remains the central focus of real estate sector reforms.

news.title: MahaRERA slaps ₹20,000 cost on builder, orders handing over of plot in 30 days
news.para: MahaRERA ordered a developer to give possession of a plot within thirty days.  The homebuyer paid the full amount in two thousand seventeen.  The builder must also pay statutory interest for nearly seven years.  MahaRERA rejected the developer's defense regarding customisation requests.  The authority denied COVID-19 moratorium benefits and awarded litigation costs.

news.title: Indiramma LIG housing towers to come up in Hyderabad's prime locations
news.para: New Indiramma LIG housing towers will be built in prime Hyderabad locations.  These projects will offer 7680 flats across sixteen assembly constituencies.  Beneficiaries will receive land ownership and a 400 sq ft flat for six lakh rupees.  Over nineteen thousand applications have already been submitted for these housing units.  The government aims for construction completion within one year of commencement.

news.title: Gurugram builder sells same plot twice, cheats man of ₹10 lakh; arrested
news.para: A real estate developer faces charges for selling one plot of land to two different buyers. The builder allegedly took over ten lakh rupees from one buyer for a plot. This buyer later discovered the same land was sold to another person at a higher price. The accused developer is identified as Rajan Singh of Lotus Dream Projects. An FIR has been registered, and the investigation is ongoing.

news.title: RWA federation seeks mandatory NOC before property transfers in Noida
news.para: Noida RWAs seek mandatory NOCs for property transfers.  This ensures all maintenance dues are settled before ownership changes.  The Federation of Noida Residents Welfare Associations represents over 120 local associations.  This measure aims to streamline resident records and financial management.  The Noida Authority has not yet responded to this important appeal.

news.title: New fire-safety norms may shrink usable space in Rajasthan buildings
news.para: Rajasthan's local government has implemented new fire-safety rules for buildings.  These regulations require a minimum of two staircases in many structures. Architects warn this change will reduce usable carpet and built-up area.  The new norms apply to buildings requiring a fire no-objection certificate.  Builders may face challenges in planning and construction due to these requirements.

news.title: Bhubaneswar: BMC to seal 112 residential buildings for operating as commercial centres illegally
news.para: Bhubaneswar Municipal Corporation is sealing 112 residential buildings operating commercially.  A further survey will identify more such illegal commercial structures next month.  This action follows Supreme Court observations on building use deviations.  BMC aims to increase revenue by assessing commercial holding taxes accurately.  A private agency will help identify and classify new unassessed buildings.

news.title: Rajkot civic body announces two-month interest waiver on property, water tax dues
news.para: Rajkot Municipal Corporation offers a two-month interest waiver on pending tax dues. This initiative aims to encourage taxpayers to clear outstanding amounts promptly. The civic body expects over 56,000 taxpayers to benefit from this scheme. This waiver is intended to help meet the corporation's tax collection targets. Timely payments will contribute to the city's ongoing development projects.

news.title: CBI court orders charges against former DHFL promoters in ₹32,930 crore fund diversion case
news.para: In an order pronounced on Thursday, special judge Sanjeev Kumar Malhotra directed that the Wadhawan brothers face charges under various sections of the IPC, relating to criminal conspiracy, cheating, forgery and falsification of accounts.
